name: com.alexgofman.save-migration-cloud-sync
description: Offline-first saves for Unity: versioned, idempotent migrations and a load-time sanitizer, a crash-safe local store, and a cloud backup with coalesced uploads, retry, timeouts and a restore that runs the same pipeline as a local load. The core is plain C# and is tested without the engine.

samples.description: An invented aquarium save with two migrations and a sanitizer, a bootstrap component that walks through a launch, a folder that stands in for the cloud, and tests for all of it.
A legacy CloudScript handler that lets a signed-in player delete their own account. Placeholders only; review before deploying.
